\section{\texttt{encode\_source\_id}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.source_ids.encode_source_id}\index{Functions!encode\_source\_id}

Encode each identity component, reserving a colon for the tenant separator.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
encode_source_id(tenant_id: str, feedback_id: str) -> str
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{tenant\_\allowbreak{}id}] \texttt{str}, required.
  \item[\texttt{feedback\_\allowbreak{}id}] \texttt{str}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{str}
\apifield{Details}The default tenant has no prefix. Percent signs are escaped along with colons, so a literal escape sequence cannot impersonate an encoded ID. Ordinary IDs such as \texttt{fb-\allowbreak{}1} and \texttt{acme:fb-\allowbreak{}1} remain unchanged.
